description: A replay of a change from atelier's history (harness/replay.py): atelier-n0qh's change (902a5a63), which marks after-merge checks on their Done when line and shows them until they are ticked on the base. The defect found after merge (defects.md row 63, atelier-secy): ticking such a check on the base makes land refuse with findings.disposed for any item whose review had a fixed fix-now finding. The reviewer of atelier-h4hi, in review, started with the task line `submit` prints, in a confined run (harness/confine.py) that cannot read the fix. Pass: a round-1 review by another thread, with a fix-now finding the judge reads as naming the known defect. Reported: whether the code supports each other fix-now finding. Needs EVAL_ATELIER and this repository's history.
